snippet.title: GreedFall: The Dying World | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Return to old-school roleplaying: https://www.nacongaming.com/en/greedfall-the-dying-world

Step back into the world of GreedFall! The Dying World sees you taken to the Old Continent, far from the lands you call home, break the bonds of your captors, reclaim your freedom and build allies. 

Your journey will carry you across lands plagued by a terrifying disease, while various factions play for position. Make choices throughout the story, who to trust, which companions to bring and how you deal with the unfolding chaos before you. Depending on your actions, allies may turn to enemies, love may bloom, and the fate of these lands will be decided.

GreedFall: The Dying World is available now on Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, & PC!
